title: OpenAcquis: open map of how EU directives are transposed into national law
description:
OpenAcquis maps how EU directives are written into national law, provision by provision and country by country: notified national measures (CELLAR), directive and national texts split into provisions with stable IDs, machine-suggested provision links with gap and extra-rule candidates, human review, and an open dataset of links from official correlation tables and human review.

This record archives the source code of a tagged release (MIT). The dataset inputs (official correlation tables in data/eval/, review records in data/reviews/) are included and the dataset is rebuilt with openacquis dataset build; the built dataset and a snapshot of the static API are attached to the GitHub release (CC-BY-4.0). Machine suggestions are candidates for review, not findings about whether a directive was transposed correctly.
notes: Code: MIT. Dataset and API data: CC-BY-4.0. EU texts © European Union (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU); national texts from e-Sbírka, Slov-Lex, RIS and gesetze-im-internet.de.
